scope: Read-only saved UTC daily transfer-history browser; original file totals plus bounded native presentation

format.blank_lines: Permitted empty lines. Known fields are not whitespace-trimmed.
format.integers: ASCII signed decimal int64, including explicit plus sign; checked additions and minute-to-millisecond multiplication.
format.start: Sets reconstructed minute anchor; parsed absolute baselines never count as usage. Nonpositive anchor is inactive until a positive start.
format.delta_and_end: While positive-anchored, advances one reconstructed minute and adds six fields when within selected UTC day/hour. End stored timestamp does not replace reconstructed minute or clear anchor.
format.duplicates: Multiple starts and duplicate/overlapping reconstructed minutes add, not overwrite.
format.rollover: A pending prior-file spill may reconstruct into the next UTC date; validated then excluded from the selected day.

native_policy.strict_validation: Every complete record validated, including inactive/outside-day records. Malformed, unsupported version, range, overflow, limit or cancellation rejects whole read; no partial plausible totals.
native_policy.presence: Empty/header-only/missing observations have unknown totals/hour cells; an actual zero adjustment creates a known zero observation. Signed adjustments remain signed.
native_policy.clock: Pure supplied-date parser has no current-time clamp. Java corpus dates are wholly before the supplied oracle clock; future/current-future-minute semantics are not Java equality-qualified.

storage.authority: Existing held profile lease and fixed relative stats/year/month/day path only.
storage.reads: No-follow regular bounded file reads; no directory scan, lease reacquisition, payload path chase, cache recovery or creation.

presentation.view: One selected UTC day, observed payload daily summary and24 hourly rows for all six original signed byte counters.
presentation.unknown: Em dash; zero only when an actual observation is present.
presentation.navigation: Explicit date change/Refresh and lazy first History activation; no timer.
presentation.ownership: Owned immutable session/request/date-bound packets; stale replies and new-profile facts rejected/cleared, hidden/minimized view defers painting/model/labels.
presentation.separate: Current saved totals, payload Activity and measured engine traffic remain independent.
presentation.original_ui_difference: Original History offers dynamic hour/day/week/month/year/all-time spans and pixel-scaled payload graphs using long-term service/cache paths. Those services and graph equivalence are not ported here.

java_oracle.authority: Complete unchanged committed LongTermStatsBase.java compiled with actual LongTermStats/Listener interfaces; minimal explicit inert providers and six-entry owned-directory subclass. No copied reader algorithm.
java_oracle.cache: Nonnull RecordAccepter disables all original cache paths.
java_oracle.native_comparison: Qualification must compare actual native results separately; source oracle collection alone is not a native pass.

limitations: No history writer, mark/reset, new measurement service or persistent global ownership.
No ordinary Core/GlobalManager/DHT/plugin/config/profile activation or original running-client access.
Fixed UTC daily browser is a deliberate bounded native policy, not complete original History/UI/runtime parity.
